description: This Java class handles file uploads via HttpServletRequest, parsing multipart form data, saving uploaded files, and validating them.

classes.name: HttpRequestFileUpload
classes.description: A utility class for processing file uploads from HTTP requests, managing file saving, and form data extraction.

methods.name: getOverrideFilename
methods.description: Returns the override filename if set.

methods.name: setOverrideFilename
methods.description: Sets a custom filename to override the uploaded filename.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the name of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getFilepath
methods.description: Returns the full path of the uploaded file.

methods.name: setSavePath
methods.description: Sets the directory path where files will be saved.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a form field by name.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to upload files and form data, saving files to disk and validating them.

methods.name: waitingReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the input stream, waiting if necessary, with timeout handling.
